decisions: Preserve all 31 existing relic IDs; redesign existing rare/epic effects and add 15 new IDs.
All reworked high-tier effects are non-stackable.
Short descriptions and named numeric parameters must share the same authored values as the runtime effects.
Each trigger is counted per active player action or explicit turn event; relic effects never recursively trigger other relics.
Images: one independent transparent built-in generation per relic; same object artwork is usable in reward cards and icons.
